Strings.proxy.title: Proxy Manager
Strings.proxy.login_required: Sign in to a RemoteOS Server to manage its proxy.
Strings.proxy.status.recovery_required: Network recovery is required before another TUN action.
Strings.proxy.status.operation_queued: The operation was queued on the Server.
Strings.proxy.status.operation_unavailable: The Server operation status is unavailable.
Strings.proxy.subtitle: Manage the host proxy runtime, profiles, traffic and network safety.
Strings.proxy.quick_actions_hint: Lifecycle requests run on the Server and report a durable operation ID.
Strings.proxy.network_protection_hint: Active connections are read from the proxy controller without exposing its secret.
Strings.proxy.recovery_required: A recovery marker is active. Restore network connectivity before enabling TUN again.
Strings.proxy.safety_hint: RemoteOS keeps controller credentials and raw proxy configuration on the Server. TUN changes are transactional and can be emergency-disabled.
Strings.proxy.profiles_hint: Profiles identify protected proxy configurations stored on the host. Activate one before enabling TUN.
Strings.proxy.proxies_hint: Choose a proxy for a controller-provided selection group.
Strings.proxy.connections_hint: Connections are bounded server-side controller data.
Strings.proxy.logs_hint: Only sanitized, bounded logs are available here.
Strings.proxy.runtime_server_file_hint: Choose a Mihomo archive already on the RemoteOS Server that matches the trusted current release.
Strings.proxy.network_settings_hint: Network-changing actions are available only when this host supports them.
Strings.proxy.operation.copying: Copying the Mihomo package from the Server…
